text:
Weekly review (batch 2 of 3). Market light YELLOW (VIX 21). Healthcare, staples, consumer and financials lead over 1 to 3 months. Tech and chips bounced last week but are still down 10-13% over a month.
Sells: SNOW and CRWD have both closed below their 50-day average for a second week, so the trend is broken and the money moves to stronger names. Last week's limit sells did not fill.
Buys: VOO (core), MCK, TMO, MA, V, KO. ABBV is skipped this week only because healthcare already has 2 names. No news argues against these buys. Their earnings are late January to early February.
NVDA reports this week. MarketPulse says Tuesday 17 Nov after the close; Earnings Whispers lists 25 Nov. Options imply a move of about 10% either way. It is a quality-dip hold with no action; disaster stop 108.64.
AMD (quality dip) rose 19% last week.

cautions.why: Earnings this week (expected move about 10%) plus the CEO investigation; the position is about 14% of the account.
